title: EIP-8372: Normalized state gas limit
description: Scales and normalizes the state-gas limit to better balance state-gas and execution-gas utilization.
author: Anders Elowsson (@anderselowsson)

notice.title: Decision deferred until Glamsterdam is live
notice.text: EIP-8368 and EIP-8372 are alternatives to one another. Both remain provisionally proposed for Hegotá pending at least 30 days of mainnet data from Glamsterdam, and are expected to be revisited on an ACDE call once that data is available.

laymanDescription: Blocks under the new state gas rules reserve as much room for creating state as for running code, but real demand rarely splits evenly, leaving one side underused. This re-tunes the price of new state and resizes its share of the block so both fill up at roughly the same rate.
benefits: Balances the state gas and execution gas equilibrium for higher throughput
tradeoffs: Introduces a new constant that will need to be tuned manually for the hard fork based on observed elasticities
